cutoff_window.rule: Only sources visibly published or updated within the last 7 days qualify.

qualifying_updates.visible_date: 2026-10-01 and 2026-09-29 entries; page updated 2026-10-04/2026-10-05 as displayed by Help Center
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI Business release notes added Admin Console management for plugins and marketplaces on October 1. September 29 entries added Codex Cloud isolated task workspaces, team-approved tool connections, team tasks, shared Pages and Spaces, and @ChatGPT in Slack and Microsoft Teams with admin-configured instructions, connections, and connected-account permissions.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Shared-channel and team-agent workflows now need evidence for installation authority, approved connections, shared recurring task ownership, isolated cloud workspaces, and channel access rather than treating chat launch as sufficient control.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Local ingest should preserve the distinction between team workflow evidence and broad product coverage, which belongs upstream.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI added computer use to the Agents API, describing tasks in an OpenAI-hosted browser with website access approvals and application-handled sign-in. The same changelog released GPT-6.1 Sol for complex coding and professional work and noted beta multi-agent delegation through Responses API requests.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Hosted browser execution and multi-agent delegation make browser/runtime boundaries, approval handling, model-route selection, and portability layers explicit evaluation points for local practice.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: For local synthesis, focus on approval/session/runtime evidence; route model and API product background upstream.

qualifying_updates.visible_date: Updated 2 days ago as displayed during the run
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI documented workspace and group policies for in-app browser, Browser Use, and Computer Use, including site access, uploads, downloads, CDP/debug access, approval duration, saved approvals, native application allow/block rules, and the rule that user approvals cannot override administrator restrictions.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Enterprise browser and computer-use policies are concrete local evidence for execution-edge authorization, browser-agent runtime boundaries, and sensitive-data/supply-chain controls around apps, origins, uploads, downloads, and debug access.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest should keep admin-policy controls local and avoid turning the page into a product encyclopedia.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Google Cloud announced a Google Cloud CLI remote MCP server preview that packages gcloud and bq command operations behind a managed remote MCP server and isolated Google Cloud execution sandbox.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: A managed remote CLI MCP server changes portability and authorization review: teams should distinguish protocol-level interoperability from managed execution, cloud identity, command breadth, and sandbox evidence.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad MCP and Google Cloud background upstream; keep local implications about command scope, sandboxing, identity, and evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: InfoQ reported a CodeScene case study where coding agents refactored a 300,000-line C codebase over three weeks using a CodeHealth MCP quality signal and replay-trace harness. The work reportedly changed 252,055 lines across 726 files and was merged to a fork through 54 pull requests, while projected defect and token-waste improvements were extrapolated rather than measured in that case.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Large agentic refactoring needs behavior-preserving harnesses, deterministic quality signals, small review units, and careful separation between measured evidence and projected benefits.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: If ingested, emphasize measured trace/review evidence and explicitly caveat extrapolated claims.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: AP reported Nvidia announcing an Open Agent Safety Platform with sandbox and monitoring components intended to contain autonomous agent behavior amid safety concerns.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Independent containment and monitoring controls are relevant to execution-edge authorization and solution evaluation, but local synthesis should treat product details as broad ecosystem coverage and retain only the control-plane implication.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as local evidence for independent containment/monitoring requirements, not as a vendor page.
